candidates.change_summary: Invert the returned boolean so approvedToLog returns the negation of the stored logger status.
Delete the assignment statement so setApprovedLogger no longer updates approvedLoggers.
Replace the owner check with a check against address(0) so anyone can call setApprovedLogger and write arbitrary mapping entries.
Set approvedLoggers[_logger] to the negation of _status instead of _status.
Write to approvedLoggers[msg.sender] instead of approvedLoggers[_logger].
Delete the state update so approvedLoggers is never modified.
Remove the onlyOwner guard so any caller can set an approved logger.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners (with a nonzero owner set) can pass the modifier.
Change the final return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so the function always returns false.
Change the guard's early return from `return false;` to `return true;` so unapproved callers return true without emitting.
Invert the guard condition to `if (approvedToLog(msg.sender)) return false;` so approved callers are rejected and unapproved callers emit and return true.
Delete the approval-check statement so unapproved callers also emit and return true instead of returning false.
